h1: Collection O Bangkok Cha Cha Suite — Budget with a Balcony on Chokchai 4, Lat Phrao
intro: Chokchai 4 is one of Bangkok's best-kept local food streets — moo kata (Thai BBQ hotpot), papaya salad, grilled skewers, noodle shops open past midnight. Collection O The Bangkok Cha Cha Suite sits quietly on Soi 27, just a short stroll from this strip. It's a no-frills 3-star hotel with 55 rooms, all featuring private balconies, free on-site parking and staff that guests consistently describe as warm and helpful. Score 8.4/10 from 234 Trip.com reviews, with rates from approx. ฿380–฿750/night — a solid value pick for anyone using Lat Phrao as their Bangkok base.

body.html: Set the expectations right from the start: 1/620 Chokchai 4 Soi 27 is not central Bangkok. The nearest MRT (Phahon Yothin) is roughly a 10-minute drive, and reaching the BTS network requires a 15–20-minute Grab ride. What Collection O The Bangkok Cha Cha Suite offers instead is peace, space and value — a quiet soi, free parking, and rooms that feel larger than their price tag suggests. Those who book knowing this consistently leave satisfied.

The standard Deluxe Double measures 25 sq m — spacious by budget Bangkok standards. Each room comes with a private balcony, minibar fridge, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free Wi-Fi, secure key-card entry, and a bathroom fitted with both a separate shower and a bidet. Built-in wardrobes, ample drawer space and a desk mean you can actually unpack for longer stays. One recurring caveat in reviews: rooms close to the lift shaft can pick up noise at night — worth mentioning at check-in when requesting your room.
"Staff are great, helpful, friendly and polite — 24-hour reception always ready to help. Free parking, clean rooms, street food just around the corner."

The location that some guests flag as remote is actually a selling point for the right traveller. The soi is calm, the noise level is low, and nearby restaurants cater to locals rather than tourists — which means better prices and more authentic flavours. Chokchai 4's main strip is roughly a five-minute walk and runs until late with Thai BBQ, papaya salad stalls and noodle shops. Tesco Lotus is a short drive. Central Plaza Ladprao, with MRT Phahon Yothin right outside, is around 10 minutes by car — viable for a day trip to central Bangkok without committing to a pricier address.

The hotel's most consistent compliment across platforms is its staff. The 24-hour front desk is described in review after review as attentive, approachable, and proactive about helping with local transport and food recommendations. Luggage storage is available. Buffet breakfast is offered under select room packages — verify at booking, as it can be good value if included. Free on-site parking seals the deal for travellers arriving by car from upcountry.

Honest note: if your daily itinerary revolves around BTS hopping across Sukhumvit or the riverside, the Grab costs from this address will eat into any savings from the room rate. And with no pool, gym or in-house restaurant, this isn't a hotel where you can fill your downtime without leaving the building. What it is, with rates from approximately ฿380 to ฿750/night, is one of the better-reviewed budget options actually on the Lat Phrao corridor — straightforward, clean, and staffed by people who seem to genuinely care.

highlights.title: Private Balcony in Every Room
highlights.text: All 25 sq m Deluxe rooms include a private balcony, minibar, free Wi-Fi and a bathroom with separate shower and bidet — more than expected at this price point.

highlights.title: Free On-Site Parking
highlights.text: Complimentary parking within the hotel grounds — a genuine rarity for Bangkok budget hotels and a major draw for guests arriving from other provinces.

highlights.title: Chokchai 4 Street Food on Your Doorstep
highlights.text: The Chokchai 4 food strip is a 5-minute walk. Local-priced Thai BBQ, papaya salad and noodle stalls stay open past midnight — no need for tourist-area markups.

honestSummary: Collection O Bangkok Cha Cha Suite delivers genuine value for budget-conscious travellers who want a private balcony, free parking and kind staff at under ฿800/night. The trade-off is clear: no pool, no gym, no easy BTS access. Know what you're signing up for, and you'll leave satisfied.
honestChecks: If you're relying on BTS every day — Grab fares from this address add up quickly. Consider a hotel closer to a station to avoid spending your savings on rides.
If you need a pool, gym or on-site dining — this hotel doesn't have any of those. Look at The Quarter Ladprao or similar mid-range options in the area instead.
If you're a light sleeper — request a room away from the lift shaft at check-in. Several reviewers noted noise from the elevator mechanism during the night.

tips.title: Request a Room Away from the Lift
tips.body: A small but useful ask at check-in — several guests noted the lift mechanism can be heard in nearby rooms. A minor tweak that makes a real difference to sleep quality.

tips.title: Explore Chokchai 4 After Dark
tips.body: Head out to the Chokchai 4 main road from around 6pm — the street food scene peaks between 6pm and 10pm with local-priced Thai BBQ, grilled skewers and fresh noodles.

tips.title: Pre-book Your Morning Grab
tips.body: The soi can be slow for Grab pickups during rush hour. Schedule your ride 10–15 minutes before you need to leave, especially for early flights or appointments.

tips.title: Tesco Lotus is a Short Drive
tips.body: Stock up on snacks, drinks or travel essentials at the nearby Tesco Lotus — about 5 minutes by car. Useful if you want to keep the minibar stocked cheaply.

faqTitle: FAQ — Collection O Bangkok Cha Cha Suite

faq.q: Where is Collection O Bangkok Cha Cha Suite located? Is it near the MRT?
faq.a: The hotel is at 1/620 Chokchai 4 Soi 27, Lat Phrao, Bangkok. The nearest MRT station (Phahon Yothin) is about 10 minutes by car. The BTS network requires a 15–20-minute Grab ride. This address works best for guests with a car or who are comfortable using Grab regularly.

faq.q: How much does a room cost at Collection O Bangkok Cha Cha Suite?
faq.a: Rates typically start from approximately ฿380–฿750 per night for a 25 sq m Deluxe Double Room. Prices vary by date and package — some include a buffet breakfast. Always compare rates across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Bangkok Cha Cha Suite have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — free on-site parking is available for hotel guests. This is one of the hotel's standout features and a key reason guests from upcountry or those with rental cars choose it as their Bangkok base.

faq.q: What food options are available near the hotel?
faq.a: The Chokchai 4 street food strip is about a 5-minute walk. It's active from evening through midnight with Thai BBQ (moo kata), papaya salad, noodle shops and grilled skewers at local prices. 7-Eleven is also within walking distance.
